newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa gold index below 1,000, lowest in 4 years.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa gold index below 1,000, lowest in 4 years.

text.p: South Africa's all gold index fell through the 1,000 level for the first time in more than four years on Friday, weighed by weakness in the bullion price.
The index was last trading below 1,000 in March 1993.
At 1238 GMT the gold index touched 999.1, a loss of 9.3 points on the day as bullion bobbed between the $336.20 and $336.50 level, just ahead of its February 12 four-year low of $336.15.
"It's tough situation on gold shares. The gold price is not doing very well," one dealer on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange said.
Bullion came under pressure in early European business as many dealing houses, mainly based in London and Europe, went short looking to force the pace of the downside.
